name: delivery-video
description: Turn a feature that actually runs into a trustworthy delivery demo video, or a defect into a traceable feedback video: real screen recordings, edge-tts narration, word-synced subtitles and a deterministic quality gate.

interface.shortDescription: Record and gate delivery demo videos
interface.longDescription: Records real screen sessions of working software, renders narration and word-synced subtitles, and runs a deterministic quality gate before the video is delivered. The same pipeline produces defect/feedback videos with severity and repro/actual chips plus a hashed issue report. No static screenshots, mocks or stale footage.
